ns0:g.ns0:text: Overall mass-transfer coefficients combine film resistances on one driving-force basis

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: Henry convention p*=HC with pressure/concentration units, same coefficients as771. K
(4−1)=0.001 mol/(m²·s). H converts liquid resistance to the gas pressure basis; do not add unconverted coefficients with incompatible
